initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production modular 2D prison masonry L-corner sprite on true transparent background.
Primary request: create one precisely orthographic corner that joins a north horizontal high wall to a thin vertical wall running south, for the approved warm hand-painted prison game. This is a wall junction, not a pillar.
Input images: Image1 latest concept is shape/perspective reference, especially L-shaped corridor/cafeteria corner; Image2 existing horizontal prison wall is exact palette/material/front-facade reference; Image3 vertical coping material is palette and narrow dark inner side reference.
Composition: portrait canvas. Occupied object is an L module with an upper horizontal arm toward RIGHT and a long narrow vertical arm down the LEFT. Overall occupied bounds ratio WIDTH:HEIGHT=80:150. LEFT vertical arm is exactly 24 of80 width, upper horizontal arm is full80 wide. The coping/top begins flat at top y0 and has depth24 of150. The main beige TOP surface forms ONE uninterrupted L: full width80 across top24 high, then continues straight DOWN at x0..20 to bottom150. A narrow cool gray inner side plane x20..24 follows the long southbound arm. Upper horizontal wall's front facade exists ONLY to the RIGHT of the vertical arm (x24..80), from y24 to y113.5, with muted beige plaster above a charcoal gray masonry plinth. Bottom113.5..150 to the right of vertical arm is completely transparent. The horizontal arm right boundary is a straight clean tileable crop, no end pillar. The vertical arm bottom is a straight clean tileable crop with no south endface, so it can continue seamlessly.
Structural priority: at the corner top surface turns 90 degrees naturally and continuously. NO independent tall frontal column on the left. NO tall frontal face on vertical arm. NO ribbon beginning beneath a pillar foot. NO diagonal isometric edges: all exterior edges screen-horizontal/screen-vertical. Clear pale coping20 wide +4 narrow darkside on southgoing strip, stone seams only every~40world. The join between top and facade is one natural shaded inside corner.
Style: warm desaturated limestone, quiet worn stucco, soft illustrated stone mottling and sparse hairline cracks, restrained dark outlines, exact same style as horizontal wall reference. Gentle illumination from upperleft, intrinsic shading only.
Constraints: produce a single isolated reusable sprite, opaque solid wall shape with alpha=0 outside. No ground, floor, characters, text, icons, vignette, baked cast shadow or checkerboard. Do not draw a framed rectangular slab or boxed column. Preserve genuine transparency. No gutters inside solid wall. Fill most canvas leaving only a modest transparent outer margin.
